From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@clearbridge.com>

Cc: Steven Park <steven.park@clearbridge.com>

Subject: Security intake — gaps in MAP evidence & DPA retention question

Hi Irene / Jonas,

Thanks again for last week's demo. We reviewed the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and ran it past our security intake. A few specific asks came up we need to resolve before legal will sign:

- SOC 2: we only have the summary statement in the MAP. Can you provide the full SOC 2 attestation PDF (redacted items ok) and confirmation of the control period?
- SIG/CAIQ: we expected a completed CAIQ matrix — the MAP links to a subset of controls. Can you share a matrix (even redacted) that maps Redwood's controls to the CAIQ questions so our assessor can triage?
- DPA / retention: we need to propose a firm data retention window for customer prompts & KV cache and a clause for EU residency option. Our legal team will likely request DPA redlines.

Timing: ClearBridge wants to close this pilot by end of March. If we can get artifacts and a DPA redline within the next 7–10 business days, we can keep to that timeline. Can your team confirm?

Also attaching a short intake checklist (see inline list below) — we can use that as the acceptance criteria.

Acceptance checklist (security):
* SOC 2 attestation (PDF) + date range
* CAIQ matrix (mapped controls)
* Draft DPA with proposed retention clause
* Answers to three privacy Qs (encryption at rest, key management, access logs)

Let me know if you want to hop on a 30-min sync this week.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Security Operations
ClearBridge Capital

Thanks Alicia — and really appreciate the clear checklist. Short answer: yes, we can meet the artifacts request and propose a DPA redline. Here's the plan from our side and the owner for each item so we can align to your March close target:

Plan / owners / ETA:
- SOC 2 attestation (redacted PDF + control period): Neha (security) — deliver by Wed 2028-02-14 EOD.
- SIG/CAIQ matrix (control mapping): Marcus (compliance) — will produce a redacted CAIQ spreadsheet and mapping by Thu 2028-02-15.
- Draft DPA redline (retention + EU residency option): Jonas (sales + legal liaison) — initial redline circulating Tue 2028-02-13 for your review; final doc Wed 2028-02-15.
- Answers to privacy Qs (encryption at rest, KMS, access logging): Neha — included with the SOC 2 packet.

Operational notes:
- For retention, our standard hosted offering maintains ephemeral prompt caches by default (30 days) and persistent customer indexes for 90 days; we can propose 30/90/365 options and a contract schedule for EU residency on Dedicated/Private deployments. We'll include explicit language and escape hatches in the proposed DPA.
- If ClearBridge needs a narrower retention window for the pilot, we can commit to 30 days for pilot data with an explicit archival/segregation plan.

Next steps:
1) I'll send the SOC2 attestation and a short KMS/access log note by Wednesday.
2) Jonas will share a DPA redline on Tuesday.
3) Marcus will add the CAIQ mapping on Thursday.

If that schedule works, can we confirm a short decision checkpoint on Fri 2028-02-16 to review artifacts and call out any major open bullets? If preferred, we can do a 30-min sync on Thu 2028-02-15.

Thanks — we'll treat this as a high priority to keep your March cadence.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Hi all,

Following up with the artifacts we've prepared for ClearBridge — attaching the SOC 2 attestation and a short 'controls summary' doc that maps to the CAIQ categories. A few comments inline:

- SOC 2 attestation (attached): control period 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31. Redacted customer names per our policy.
- CAIQ mapping (attached): we mark items not applicable (N/A) where responsibility shifts to cloud provider. Marcus will expand any open items you flag.
- KMS & access logs: we use customer-specific CMKs for Dedicated & Private customers; hosted customers may use Redwood-managed keys with customer KMS integration options. Access logs: token-level request logs kept for 180 days by default; we will include a policy excerpt.

- Production: default 90 days; option to contract to 365 days or on-premise residency for EU requirements
- Escrow/archival: we can provide an agreed escrow snapshot for legal hold scenarios (separate SOW)

Irene / team — thank you, that schedule looks good and the artifacts we received are helpful. Quick notes and asks before we move the DPA to legal redline: 

- SOC2: received and sufficient for intake triage. We'll keep the doc internal to our assessor (no public posting).
- CAIQ mapping: the controls summary helps; our assessor will follow up on two control families (cryptography key lifecycle and data deletion proofs) — Marcus, can you expand those cells?
- Retention & DPA: the 30-day pilot window is acceptable. For production we will propose 90 days by default. Legal expects a redline with the EU residency clause; Jonas, please include a DocuSign-ready copy.

Can we lock the Thursday 2pm PT sync (2028-02-15 14:00 PT)? If so, please send a calendar invite and include a link to the HubSpot deal record so our procurement team can track acceptance.

If we get the DPA redline today or tomorrow, legal will aim to turn around comments within 48 hours. Closing target: March 29 pilot start still looks feasible if we keep this cadence.

Thanks again — talk tomorrow.

— Alicia
